info.title: MediCore Smart Hospital API
info.description:
REST API of the MediCore hospital system (admin, doctor and patient portals). Everything below is generated from the running router and its validators; response schemas are checked against live responses by the test-suite.

**Authentication.** `POST /auth/login` returns a JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each operation lists the roles allowed to call it (`x-roles`); a wrong role is `403 FORBIDDEN`, a missing/invalid token `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`. Socket.IO uses the same token.

**Responses.** Success: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "message"?: … }`. Error: `{ "success": false, "message", "error": { "code", "status", "details"? }, "requestId" }`. Branch on `error.code`, never on `message`. HTTP status codes are the ones listed per operation.

**Request ids.** Every response carries `X-Request-Id` (also `requestId` in error bodies). Send your own (8–64 characters of `A–Z a–z 0–9 . _ -`) to correlate a call with the server log.

**Deprecated duplicates.** The authentication responses and `/health` still repeat `token`, `user`, `status`, `time` at the top level for older clients, and errors repeat `details`. Use the `data` / `error` fields.

**Downloads.** `GET /files/reports/{id}`, `GET /files/prescriptions/{id}/pdf` and `GET /admin/reports/{type}?format=csv` return files, not JSON; failures are still the JSON error body.

**Clinical data and administrators.** Administrators see clinical detail only with `X-Access-Reason` (10–500 characters); every such access is audited. Deleting clinical items is a soft deletion (restorable).

**Pagination.** Paged lists return `data: { items, pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`; other lists return a bare array in `data`.

**Real-time events (Socket.IO, not REST).** Connect to the server root path `/socket.io` with `auth: { token }`. Events carry the payload object itself (no envelope): `notification:new`, `appointment:updated`, `emergency:new`, `emergency:updated`, `emergency:alert`. See `x-socketio`.

All example data in this document is fictitious.

get.summary: Operational report (JSON, or CSV download with ?format=csv)
get.description:
Requires sign-in as: ADMIN.

Administrators must send `X-Access-Reason` (10–500 characters, URL-encoded); the access is audited. Without it the API answers `400 REASON_REQUIRED`.

Patient-identifying report types (`patients`, `appointments`, `emergencies`, `complaints`) need the reason, are limited to a 366-day range and are audited as `REPORT_EXPORTED`. `doctors` and `departments` are aggregate and need no reason.

200.description: JSON report (default), or — with `?format=csv` — a CSV file download (second content type; `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<type>-report-<date>.csv"`). CSV failures are the normal JSON error body.

AccessReason.name: X-Access-Reason
AccessReason.description: Why an administrator needs this clinical information (URL-encoded text, 10–500 characters). Required for administrators on downloads, patient-identifying reports and clinical restores (`400 REASON_REQUIRED` without it); on patient and emergency detail it unlocks the clinical sections, which are otherwise withheld. Ignored for doctors and patients. Audited.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional correlation id (8–64 characters of A–Z a–z 0–9 . _ -). Echoed on the response; otherwise the server generates one.
Identifies the request in the server log

ValidationError.description: The request is not acceptable: VALIDATION_ERROR (details = [{field, message}]), BAD_REQUEST, MALFORMED_JSON, UPLOAD_ERROR, REASON_REQUIRED, EXPORT_RANGE_TOO_LARGE or EXPORT_RANGE_INVALID

value.message: limit: limit must be at most 100
A reason is required to view clinical information

Unauthenticated.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: no, invalid or expired token, a deactivated account, or wrong credentials. Clients should sign the user out.

Forbidden.description: FORBIDDEN: signed in but not allowed (wrong role, no care relationship, not alerted for the emergency…)

value.message: You do not have permission to perform this action

Conflict.description: CONFLICT: state conflict (duplicate e-mail, slot taken, already accepted…)

value.message: An account with this email already exists

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED (honour Retry-After) or, on sign-in, ACCOUNT_LOCKED (details.retryAfterSeconds)

value.message: Too many requests. Please slow down.
Too many failed sign-in attempts for this account. Try again in 15 minute(s).

ServerError.description: INTERNAL_ERROR: unexpected failure. The message is generic; quote requestId to find the cause in the server log.

value.message: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

Success.description: Every successful JSON response. `data` carries the payload and is omitted when there is nothing to return.

Pagination.description: Position within a paginated list. `page` and `limit` echo the request (defaults 1 and 20; `limit` at most 100). A page past the end returns empty `items` with the real `totalItems`. `total` repeats `totalItems` for older clients (deprecated).

totalItems.description: Number of items matching the filters, across all pages

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Branch on this, never on `message`.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error response. Stack traces, SQL, file paths, request bodies, tokens and clinical data never appear in it. `details` repeats `error.details` for older clients (deprecated).

message.description: Safe text that may be shown to the user

details.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: array of {field, message}. REASON_REQUIRED: {code, minLength, maxLength}. ACCOUNT_LOCKED: {retryAfterSeconds}.

requestId.description: Same value as the X-Request-Id response header; quote it to find the cause in the server log

MessageOnly.description: Success with only a confirmation message (no data)

SessionUser.description: The signed-in account. `profile` is the admin, doctor or patient record of the user (its fields depend on `role`).

token.description: A fresh JWT; the previous tokens of the account stop working

consultationFee.description: Decimal number serialised as a string
Decimal number serialised as a string

heightCm.description: Decimal number serialised as a string

weightKg.description: Decimal number serialised as a string

AdminPatientDetail.description: Administrators receive the clinical sections only with a recorded access reason (X-Access-Reason); otherwise `clinicalWithheld` is true and the clinical arrays are empty or absent.

heightCm.description: Decimal number serialised as a string

weightKg.description: Decimal number serialised as a string

DoctorPatientRecord.description: A patient's chart as seen by a doctor. `access` states why the doctor may see it (TREATMENT, EMERGENCY, HISTORICAL) and whether they may write.

notes.description: Clinical notes: never sent to administrators

MedicalReport.description: An uploaded report (metadata; the file itself is downloaded from GET /files/reports/{id}). `fileName` is the original name; `storedName` is the opaque random name the file has in storage (never a path).

latitude.description: Decimal number serialised as a string

longitude.description: Decimal number serialised as a string

ReportResult.description: A tabular report. With ?format=csv the same data is downloaded as text/csv instead (see the operation's second response).

Broadcast.description: A sent broadcast, from the audit log; the audit details (audience, title, type, recipients) are included.

x-socketio.description: Socket.IO server on the same host (path /socket.io). Authenticate with auth: { token: <JWT> }; the connection closes when the token expires. Payloads are plain objects (not enveloped); clinical text is never included in alerts.

appointment:updated.audience: the patient and doctor of the appointment; administrators receive an admin view without clinical text

emergency:updated.audience: administrators, alerted doctors and the patient
